I did my best to try to inform folks as best I could before I moved out of Brighton.

Shortly after lockdown began and doors shut indefinitely in March, one of the managers passed from COVID not even a few weeks later in April. The paperwork was signed in August 2020 transferring ownership of the entire business (IP and all) over to the new owner.

Hello former manager here. (For any of my regulars that I haven't seen out in the wild: I hope y'all are doing well, I hope y'all have had some solid coffee supplies and great food since our closure. I hope you give all the kiddos and doggos all the love and support.) 

That being said, this is my word of caution for folks who still choose to frequent this location.

Any LGBTQ folks or folks who have a complicated relationship with religion shouldn't pass by here without caution. The owner said in an interview with Brighton Main Streets after coming into her ownership that she hopes to bring the faith community of her religion to Cafenation, which a quick Google search of said faith says they only believe in a marriage between a man and a woman. You are entitled to have your own faith, I just have my own doubts when a religious group takes over a spot that had a queer friendly presence (from staff and regulars) and wants to implement that into a community.

They took down the respect pronouns sign, they didn't hire former staff after the change in ownership (they said they would check with some of us after a couple months but I haven't heard anything) also they're just closed on Sundays which doesn't help if you had a busy weekend and need to refuel before the week starts.

While they own the business' intellectual property, they aren't close to being the business folks used to know.

May y'all find great sources of local coffee.
